classifications.rationale: The President presently establishes the Federal Flood Risk Management Standard; the legal standard exists upon issuance, while agency implementation follows later.
The President immediately makes a limiting housekeeping amendment to an existing executive order governing agency administration, without dictating a later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: Section 2 is amended by inserting ", to the extent permitted by law"

classifications.rationale: The President amends an existing executive order by removing part of its internal methodology for agency floodplain determinations; the administrative amendment occurs immediately.
In context, this agency determination procedure is quoted text being removed from the prior executive order, making its repeal an immediate internal-management amendment.
classifications.evidence: the agency shall make a determination of the location of the floodplain based on the best-available information

classifications.rationale: The President replaces prior guidance and assigns agencies a mandatory methodology for later internal floodplain determinations, but does not dictate the determinations' substantive results.
classifications.evidence: the agency shall use one of the approaches in Section 6(c) of this Order

classifications.rationale: The President directs agencies, where possible, to use specified approaches while developing alternatives; this governs discretionary agency implementation rather than imposing a legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: Where possible, an agency shall use natural systems, ecosystem processes, and nature-based approaches

classifications.rationale: The President makes an immediate housekeeping amendment updating an official's title in an existing executive order.
The President requires agencies' later regulations and procedures to achieve the specified legal result of consistency with the FFRMS.
classifications.evidence: The regulations and procedures must also be consistent with the Federal Flood Risk Management Standard (FFRMS).

classifications.rationale: The President immediately amends the governing instruction so that agencies must incorporate the FFRMS into later regulations and procedures, dictating their required legal content.
classifications.evidence: Section 3(a) is further amended by inserting "and FFRMS"

classifications.rationale: The President presently revises the binding definition and required establishment of the floodplain, including fixed elevation alternatives and exceptions; agencies apply those already-created legal parameters later.
classifications.evidence: The floodplain shall be established using one of the following approaches

classifications.rationale: The President presently adopts a binding definition of critical action, which immediately determines the term's scope for the amended order.
classifications.evidence: The term 'critical action' shall mean any activity for which even a slight chance of flooding would be too great.

classifications.rationale: The Mitigation Framework Leadership Group must later provide advisory recommendations after reviewing public comments; no specified legal outcome is required.
classifications.evidence: the Mitigation Framework Leadership Group shall provide recommendations to the Water Resources Council

classifications.rationale: The Water Resources Council and each agency must later issue or amend guidance, regulations, and procedures to achieve the specified result of compliance with the order and Standard.
classifications.evidence: each agency shall, in consultation with the Water Resources Council, Federal Interagency Floodplain Management Task Force, Federal Emergency Management Agency, and Council on Environmental Quality, issue or amend existing regulations and procedures to comply with this order

classifications.rationale: Agencies must submit internal implementation plans and observe an administrative sequencing restriction before issuing regulations; the segment does not prescribe a distinct substantive legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: each agency shall submit an implementation plan to the National Security Council staff

classifications.rationale: The Council and Leadership Group must conduct recurring review, consultation, recommendations, and warranted guideline amendments without a predetermined substantive result.
classifications.evidence: shall reassess the Standard annually, after seeking stakeholder input, and provide recommendations

classifications.rationale: The Water Resources Council must periodically update the Standard but retains authority to determine the update's content; the accompanying clauses preserve existing executive authority and functions.
classifications.evidence: The Water Resources Council shall issue an update to the Standard at least every 5 years.

classifications.rationale: The Water Resources Council must consult another executive body while performing its assigned responsibilities, an internal coordination requirement.
classifications.evidence: shall carry out its responsibilities under this order in consultation with the Mitigation Framework Leadership Group
